Subject: MAP kickoff + ask: region & initial GPU mix for Dedicated/Private

Isaac / Quadriga team — thanks again for the call today. As promised, attaching the first-pass MAP workbook (MAP_QBG_v1.xlsx) and a short network diagram. Goal for this thread: lock the committed SKU mix per region and agree on the evaluation/PO timeline so we can schedule Dedicated capacity build + Private pilot.

Top asks from our side (short):
- Confirm primary region for go-live (we recommend US-West-2 as primary for latency to your NW customers)
- Confirm preferred GPU family and rough counts for initial commit (see table in attachment)
- Agree target throughput (concurrent inference QPS / tokens-per-second) for the evaluation period (we used 100 qps @ 512 tokens/sec as a placeholder)

Quick notes:
- We can support a mixed Dedicated + Private deployment: Dedicated in US-West-2, Private pilot in your Azure subscription in US-East if you want on-prem-like control.
- Typical MAP cadence: weekly checkpoints until contract signature, then bi-weekly during onboarding.

Please reply with region + preferred GPU family (A100-80GB / H100 / A30) and an initial count. I captured action owners in the attached tab but will synthesize in the next message.

Attachments: MAP_QBG_v1.xlsx (workbook), network-arch-v2.pdf (diagram)

Thanks,

Rachel — thanks for the quick follow. We reviewed the MAP internally this morning. High level:

- Primary region: US-West-2 (agreed)
- Preferred GPU family: H100 for most latency-sensitive models; fallback A100-80GB where H100 not available.
- Initial counts: H100 x 12 (US-West-2), A100-80GB x 4 (burst pool)
- Throughput target for eval: 150 qps sustained @ 256 tokens average (~38k tokens/sec aggregate), burst to 300 qps for peak test windows.

Procurement asked for a draft SOW and a target signature date: we are aiming to sign by 2027-07-08. Can Redwood commit to a build schedule that will have Dedicated nodes provisioned in staging by 2027-06-28 for evaluation?

Isaac — that GPU mix looks reasonable. A couple of operational notes from the capacity team: 

- Provisioning target: we can reserve H100 x12 + A100 x4 in US-West-2 for a staging environment by 2027-06-28 provided the deposit/commitment is in place by 2027-06-20.
- Throughput sizing: for 150 qps @ 256 tokens average across ensemble models we recommend the following runtime tuning before committing larger counts:
  - Batch size cap: 8 for latency-sensitive routes
  - KV cache warmup plan: pre-warm top-10 prefixes during evaluation windows to reduce cold-start tail latency
- Fallbacks: plan a cross-region failover to US-East (A100-only) with reduced throughput (50 qps) for DR.

I'll attach a short runbook after Rachel consolidates the MAP actions.
